mechanism_narrative: The sustained low levels and slight further decline in RETAIL_REC, coupled with persistently high RESIDENTIAL mobility, indicate continued severe restrictions on movement, which will keep retail activity suppressed over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, indicating an unexpected easing of restrictions or behavioral shift.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM mobility continues its recent upward trend and rises by more than 5 percentage points week-on-week, it will signal a broader increase in essential outings that will spill over into a slight recovery for RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM rises by more than 5 points week-on-week, but RETAIL_REC continues to decline or remains flat over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated increase in both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility, indicating a policy-driven return to work and public transport usage, will directly facilitate and drive an increase in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as more people move through the city.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both rise > 5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both rise by more than 5 points week-on-week, but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: As long as RESIDENTIAL mobility remains above 30% change from baseline, indicating continued adherence to stay-at-home orders, the lack of foot traffic will prevent any significant recovery in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility remains above 30%, yet RETAIL_REC shows a sustained increase over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The persistent and deepening decline in RETAIL_REC mobility, reaching its lowest point in the last four weeks, indicates a strong negative momentum that will continue to suppress retail and recreation activity over the next one week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows a significant week-on-week increase in the next 7 days, reversing its recent trend.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS mobility increases by more than 10 percentage points week-on-week, it will indicate an easing of outdoor activity restrictions, which will subsequently lead to a modest increase in RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks as people venture out more.
failure_condition: PARKS mobility rises by more than 10 points week-on-week, but RETAIL_REC remains stagnant or declines over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM mobility ceases its slight recovery and remains below -70% while RESIDENTIAL mobility stays above 30%, it indicates a continued focus on essential-only trips and strict home confinement, which will keep RETAIL_REC suppressed over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays below -70% and RESIDENTIAL stays above 30%
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM remains below -70% and RESIDENTIAL above 30%, yet RETAIL_REC shows a significant increase over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of easing restrictions, a drop in RESIDENTIAL mobility below 30% from its current high levels would signify a substantial increase in overall population movement, directly leading to a recovery in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility falls below 30%, but RETAIL_REC does not show a sustained increase over the next 28 days.
